Which island trip from Koh Samui is best? | When it is open (16 December–31 October), Ang Thong Marine Park is the most spectacular day: 42 islands, the Emerald Lake and a 360° viewpoint, from 1,500 THB. For families, half days or the rainy season, Pig Island and Koh Tan from Thong Krut (1,450 THB) is the easiest choice.
Can you visit Ang Thong in November? | No. Ang Thong National Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December. In that window our Pig Island and Koh Tao trips run instead, sea permitting.
What is the closest island to Koh Samui? | Koh Fan, the Big Buddha islet, is joined to Samui by a causeway, and Koh Fan Noi off Choeng Mon can be reached on a sandbar at low tide. The closest island you visit by boat is Koh Tan, 4–5 km off Thong Krut.
Can I island-hop from Samui to Phangan and Koh Tao on one tour? | Not on a tour boat: day tours always return to the island they left from. To travel on to Koh Phangan or Koh Tao, buy ferry tickets; fast boats reach Phangan in 20–50 minutes and Koh Tao in 1.5–2 hours.
Is Pig Island worth it? | Yes, if you treat it as a relaxed half day: a short crossing, the pigs on Koh Madsum, easy snorkelling at Koh Tan and a meal on the beach for 1,450 THB. It is not a wilderness park like Ang Thong, and it runs all year.
~How long is the boat from Koh Samui to Koh Tao? | Fast boats take 1.5–2 hours, most stopping at Koh Phangan on the way; slow ferries take 2.5–3.25 hours. Our Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan day trip is a full day and returns to Samui in the evening.
Do I pay island fees on top of the tour price? | Usually yes, in cash: 300 THB per adult (150 THB per child) at Ang Thong, 250 THB per adult on Koh Nang Yuan, and about 50 THB on Koh Madsum and Koh Rap. Our Pig Island longtail and sunset tours include the Koh Madsum fee.
Is a private boat worth it for a family? | Often, yes. Four adults on the shared Pig Island speedboat pay 5,800 THB, and a private longtail for up to 8 guests costs 5,950 THB per boat, with your own timing and a private transfer. Charters for other islands start at 19,000 THB per boat.
Which boat trips run in the rainy season? | Pig Island, Koh Tan and Koh Rap trips from Thong Krut run on most days in October–December, because the south-west coast is sheltered from the north-east monsoon. Koh Tao trips run when the sea allows; Ang Thong is closed 1 November–15 December.
